environment.window: Native 1200x760 content viewport, DPR2, AC power; exact per-run placement and browser identity in raw reports

transitionScope: Seventeen initial cases, three repeats per strategy. S1 failed the unannounced ancestor-position shift in all three repeats.
S0 lacks geometry/source epochs, so its formal failure count is not a count of demonstrated defects. Source-resize alone had no observed mismatch.
The original sampler mainly compared rectangles and used cached fitted-image geometry. It did not establish same-rectangle style/clip/control freshness.
The initial warming case did not prove an unready opening, and sequential scroll/source actions did not prove overlap. Stronger fixtures and an independently timed current-DOM query are required.
Correlated diagnostic samples are not independent frames or continuous physical-display exposure. Initial S2 local passes do not qualify the revised implementation.

costReport.stateTransitionScope: Natural loop rewarming/stable phases retained the neural tier. They are not tier changes or probes.

correctedAnalysis.correction: Removed an accidentally stricter total-controller-transition-zero predicate. Preregistration forbids actual tier changes/probes, not same-neural phase transitions. Raw original false safety/control flags remain untouched. Numeric bounds and limits are unchanged.
correctedAnalysis.method: Six within-block run contrasts, sample SD, df5 one-sided critical 2.0150483733. Cadence penalty is S0 minus candidate; CPU/work penalty is candidate minus S0. No frame pseudoreplication.
correctedAnalysis.scope: Both cadence upper bounds exceed the allowance. This is failed acceptance, not proof of material regression. Default timer quantization accounts for identical measured p95s and floating-point-sized differences; zero contrasts are measured differences, not zero CPU work. GPU summaries in raw are cumulative session histograms, not window quantiles; layout/style attribution and physical scanout are not measured.

review: Independent read-only audit recomputed six-pair bounds and verified all 171 raw hashes/byte counts and summaries. Classification correction PASS; milestone acceptance not approved.
confirmationReference: The original six S0 run-level values in cost-study-01.json remain the fixed arithmetic-mean reference for any later two production confirmations; no favorable replacement reference is selected.
